news.title: Google launched Gemini 3.1 Pro for complex reasoning
news.summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro rolled out in preview across AI Studio, Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, the Gemini app, NotebookLM, and other channels, boasting a 77.1% ARC-AGI-2 score and deeper reasoning for synthesis, animation, and design tasks.

news.title: OpenAI tuned GPT-5.2 Instant for clearer, grounded replies
news.summary: On February 10, OpenAI updated GPT-5.2 Instant in ChatGPT and the API to deliver more measured, context-appropriate tone, richer how-to guidance, and clearer placement of key actions for advice-seeking users.

news.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 becomes default on Claude.ai and Claude Cowork
news.summary: Anthropic made Sonnet 4.6 the default for its free and Pro tiers, highlighting a 1M-token context window, stronger coding and computer-use skills, safety evaluations, and new Excel MCP connectors while keeping Sonnet pricing.

news.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro previews for Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, and CLI
news.summary: Google Cloud confirmed Gemini 3.1 Pro is available in preview through Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, AI Studio, Android Studio, Antigravity, and the Gemini CLI, citing JetBrains, Databricks, Cartwheel, and Hostinger for reasoning, 3D, and design breakthroughs.

news.title: Nvidia inks multiyear chip deal with Meta spanning Blackwell, Rubin, Grace, and Vera
news.summary: Nvidia agreed to ship Meta millions of current and future AI GPUs (Blackwell, Rubin) plus Grace and Vera CPUs under a multiyear pact analysts estimate near $50 billion, underscoring its push into CPUs for agentic workloads while keeping hyperscaler momentum.

news.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro hits GitHub Copilot preview
news.summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro is now selectable inside GitHub Copilot for Pro/Pro+/Business/Enterprise users across VS Code, Visual Studio, github.com, and mobile, delivering faster edit-test loops with higher tool precision.

news.title: Copilot CLI 0.0.414 lets Autopilot use MCP tools with a permission dialog
news.summary: The February 21 Copilot CLI release lets Autopilot and explore agents leverage MCP tools when available and introduces a permission elevation dialog before accepting plans that would auto-deny tool calls, smoothing agentic workflows.

news.title: Power Platform February update embeds Copilot chat and MCP features
news.summary: The February Power Platform rollout added public preview of Microsoft 365 Copilot chat inside model-driven apps, a Power Apps MCP server and agent feed preview, and new builder tooling like the Card control and theme copy-paste to keep makers in flow.

news.title: Treasury publishes AI lexicon and Financial Services AI RMF
news.summary: The U.S. Treasury released an AI lexicon and a Financial Services AI Risk Management Framework to align terminology, adapt the NIST RMF for finance, and accelerate implementation of the President’s AI Action Plan in financial services.

news.title: Wall Street rebounds as Nvidia, Amazon, and other AI names recover
news.summary: Tech-heavy indexes closed higher after Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, storage vendors, and Cadence Design Systems bounced back from AI jitters, bolstered by Nvidia’s Meta chip deal and strong data-center demand.

news.title: Luxury stocks feel AI-driven volatility amid hedge fund bets
news.summary: Shares of LVMH, Kering, and Hermes are swinging sharply as hedge funds trade on fragile recovery signals while AI-driven volatility risks crimp the spending power of wealthy consumers.

news.title: Big tech valuations slip as investors question AI spending ROI
news.summary: Microsoft, Amazon, Nvidia, Apple, and Alphabet have lost roughly $1.3 trillion in combined market value so far this year as shareholders demand nearer-term returns from massive AI capital spending, even as TSMC, Samsung, and Walmart gained.
